# Owner setup (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`owner-setup`](../../flows/owner-setup/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Creates the single owner with the setup token while no owner exists (D1, [owner-setup flow](../../flows/owner-setup/FLOW.md)); then sends the owner to the login page.

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). Reachable only while `GET /setup/status` says open. The token and passwords live in form state only (never in the URL, storage or the store) and are cleared on success; field errors the API names in a 400 mark their field, anything else becomes a form alert.

## Technologies

React, react-hook-form with Zod, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

Route `/setup`, page `OwnerSetupPage`.

## Where to change what

Fields and their errors: `OwnerSetupPage.tsx`; the setup calls: `features/auth` (`Setup.api.ts`, `useSetupStatus.ts`).
